```{r setup, include=FALSE}
dtw_cache_context <- function(
  selected_files,
  model,
  participant_id,
  correlation_method,
  n_perm,
  warping_radii,
  seed,
  checkpoint_transfer_personal_weight = NULL,
  similarity_transfer_top_k = NULL
) {
  source_info <- file.info(selected_files$path)

  context <- list(
    cache_version = DTW_CACHE_VERSION,
    model = as.character(model),
    participant_id = as.character(participant_id),
    correlation_method = as.character(correlation_method),
    n_perm = as.integer(n_perm),
    seed = as.integer(seed),
    warping_radii = as.character(warping_radii),
    source_files = data.frame(
      path = normalizePath(selected_files$path, mustWork = FALSE),
      size = unname(source_info$size),
      modified_utc = format(source_info$mtime, tz = "UTC", usetz = TRUE),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  )

  # A custom transfer blend has different predictions and therefore requires
  # a separate DTW cache. The saved 60/40 blend keeps the existing cache key.
  if (!is.null(checkpoint_transfer_personal_weight)) {
    context$checkpoint_transfer_personal_weight <- sprintf(
      "%.2f",
      checkpoint_transfer_personal_weight
    )
  }

  if (!is.null(similarity_transfer_top_k)) {
    context$similarity_transfer_top_k <- as.integer(similarity_transfer_top_k)
  }

  context
}

dtw_cache_path <- function(cache_dir, context) {
  safe_part <- function(x) gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]", "_", x)
  blend_suffix <- if (!is.null(context$checkpoint_transfer_personal_weight)) {
    paste0("_personal_", context$checkpoint_transfer_personal_weight)
  } else {
    ""
  }
  similarity_suffix <- if (!is.null(context$similarity_transfer_top_k)) {
    paste0("_top_", context$similarity_transfer_top_k)
  } else {
    ""
  }

  file.path(
    cache_dir,
    paste0(
      "dtw_", safe_part(context$model),
      "_participant_", safe_part(context$participant_id),
      "_", safe_part(context$correlation_method),
      "_perm_", context$n_perm, blend_suffix, similarity_suffix, ".rds"
    )
  )
}

read_dtw_cache <- function(cache_dir, context) {
  cache_file <- dtw_cache_path(cache_dir, context)

  if (!file.exists(cache_file)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  cached <- tryCatch(readRDS(cache_file), error = function(e) NULL)

  if (
    is.null(cached) ||
    is.null(cached$context) ||
    is.null(cached$data) ||
    !identical(cached$context, context)
  ) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  cached$data
}

write_dtw_cache <- function(cache_dir, context, data) {
  dir.create(cache_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  cache_file <- dtw_cache_path(cache_dir, context)
  temporary_file <- tempfile(pattern = "dtw_cache_", tmpdir = cache_dir)
  saveRDS(list(context = context, data = data), temporary_file)

  if (!file.rename(temporary_file, cache_file)) {
    file.copy(temporary_file, cache_file, overwrite = TRUE)
    unlink(temporary_file)
  }
}


prepare_dtw_display_results <- function(dtw_df) {
  visible_dtw <- dtw_df %>%
    filter(
      !(is.finite(warping_radius) &
          warping_radius %in% DTW_HIDDEN_DISPLAY_RADII)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      warping_radius_index = match(
        warping_radius_label,
        as.character(DTW_DISPLAY_WARPING_RADII)
      )
    )

  display_summary <- visible_dtw %>%
    group_by(outcome) %>%
    summarise(
      pointwise_distance = {
        pointwise_idx <- match("0", warping_radius_label)
        if (is.na(pointwise_idx)) NA_real_ else d_real[pointwise_idx]
      },
      effective_warping_index = {
        effective_idx <- which(d_real < null_p05)[1]
        if (is.na(effective_idx)) NA_real_ else warping_radius_index[effective_idx]
      },
      effective_warping_label = {
        effective_idx <- which(d_real < null_p05)[1]
        if (is.na(effective_idx)) "None" else warping_radius_label[effective_idx]
      },
      effective_dtw_distance = {
        effective_idx <- which(d_real < null_p05)[1]
        if (is.na(effective_idx)) NA_real_ else d_real[effective_idx]
      },
      effective_dtw_p_value = {
        effective_idx <- which(d_real < null_p05)[1]
        if (is.na(effective_idx)) NA_real_ else null_p_value[effective_idx]
      },
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  visible_dtw %>%
    select(-any_of(c(
      "pointwise_distance",
      "effective_warping_index",
      "effective_warping_label",
      "effective_dtw_distance",
      "effective_dtw_p_value"
    ))) %>%
    left_join(display_summary, by = "outcome")
}

# =============================================================================
# Python helper for loading .pth files
# =============================================================================

py_run_string("
import torch
import numpy as np

def _append_rows(
    rows,
    outer_i,
    split_name,
    y_true,
    y_pred,
    y_pred_personal=None,
    y_pred_other_participants=None
):

    y_true = np.asarray(y_true).reshape(-1)
    y_pred = np.asarray(y_pred).reshape(-1)

    if len(y_true) != len(y_pred):
        return

    if y_pred_personal is not None:
        y_pred_personal = np.asarray(y_pred_personal).reshape(-1)
        if len(y_pred_personal) != len(y_pred):
            y_pred_personal = None

    if y_pred_other_participants is not None:
        y_pred_other_participants = np.asarray(y_pred_other_participants).reshape(-1)
        if len(y_pred_other_participants) != len(y_pred):
            y_pred_other_participants = None

    for j, (yt, yp) in enumerate(zip(y_true, y_pred)):
        rows.append({
            'outer_i': int(outer_i),
            'split': split_name,
            'point_i': int(j),
            'y_true': float(yt),
            'y_pred': float(yp),
            'y_pred_personal': (
                float(y_pred_personal[j]) if y_pred_personal is not None else np.nan
            ),
            'y_pred_other_participants': (
                float(y_pred_other_participants[j])
                if y_pred_other_participants is not None else np.nan
            )
        })


def similarity_matched_other_prediction(fold, top_k):

    source_predictions = fold.get('source_participant_predictions')
    similarity_info = fold.get('similarity_matched_transfer', {})
    source_similarity = similarity_info.get('source_trajectory_similarity', {})

    if not isinstance(source_predictions, dict) or not isinstance(source_similarity, dict):
        return None

    expected_length = len(np.asarray(fold.get('y_pred', [])).reshape(-1))
    candidates = []

    for source, prediction in source_predictions.items():
        try:
            similarity = float(source_similarity.get(source, np.nan))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            continue

        prediction = np.asarray(prediction).reshape(-1)
        if np.isfinite(similarity) and len(prediction) == expected_length:
            candidates.append((str(source), similarity, prediction))

    candidates.sort(key=lambda candidate: (-candidate[1], candidate[0]))

    if not candidates:
        return None

    selected_predictions = [candidate[2] for candidate in candidates[:int(top_k)]]
    return np.mean(selected_predictions, axis=0)


def load_prediction_file(path, similarity_top_k=None):

    try:
        folds = torch.load(
            path,
            map_location='cpu',
            weights_only=False
        )
    except TypeError:
        folds = torch.load(
            path,
            map_location='cpu'
        )

    rows = []

    for i, fold in enumerate(folds):

        outer_i = fold.get('outer_i', i)

        y_pred = fold.get('y_pred', [])
        y_pred_personal = fold.get('y_pred_personal')
        y_pred_other_participants = fold.get('y_pred_other_participants')

        if similarity_top_k is not None and 'source_participant_predictions' in fold:
            y_pred_other_participants = similarity_matched_other_prediction(
                fold,
                similarity_top_k
            )

            if y_pred_other_participants is None:
                raise ValueError(
                    'No valid stored source predictions were available for the requested similarity top-K.'
                )

            if y_pred_personal is None:
                y_pred_personal = fold.get('y_pred', [])

            y_pred = (
                0.60 * np.asarray(y_pred_personal).reshape(-1)
                + 0.40 * np.asarray(y_pred_other_participants).reshape(-1)
            )

        _append_rows(
            rows,
            outer_i,
            'test',
            fold.get('y_test', []),
            y_pred,
            y_pred_personal,
            y_pred_other_participants
        )

    return rows
")


# =============================================================================
# Find result files

get_available_results <- function(
  model_name
) {
  
  results_dir <- file.path(
    RESULTS_ROOT,
    model_name
  )
  
  
  files <- list.files(
    results_dir,
    pattern =
      "^results_[0-9]+_(negative|cognitive|positive)\\.pth$",
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  
  
  if (length(files) == 0) {
    
    return(
      tibble(
        path = character(),
        participant_id = character(),
        outcome = character(),
        model = character()
      )
    )
  }
  
  
  tibble(
    path = files,
    filename = basename(files)
  ) %>%
    
    extract(
      filename,
      into = c(
        "participant_id",
        "outcome"
      ),
      regex =
        "^results_([0-9]+)_(negative|cognitive|positive)\\.pth$",
      remove = TRUE
    ) %>%
    
    mutate(
      participant_id = sprintf(
        "%05d",
        as.integer(participant_id)
      ),
      model = model_name
    ) %>%
    
    arrange(
      participant_id,
      outcome
    )
}


# Only expose ensemble combinations for which every main model has a matching
# participant-outcome file. This prevents averaging different test series.
get_ensemble_available_results <- function() {

  model_results <- bind_rows(
    lapply(
      MODEL_DIRS,
      get_available_results
    )
  )

  if (nrow(model_results) == 0) {
    return(model_results)
  }

  model_results %>%
    group_by(
      participant_id,
      outcome
    ) %>%
    filter(
      n_distinct(model) == length(MAIN_MODEL_DIRS),
      n() == length(MAIN_MODEL_DIRS)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    arrange(
      participant_id,
      outcome,
      model
    )
}


# =============================================================================
# Load one result
# =============================================================================

load_predictions <- function(
  path,
  participant_id,
  outcome,
  model,
  similarity_top_k = NULL
) {
  
  rows <- if (is.null(similarity_top_k)) {
    py$load_prediction_file(path)
  } else {
    py$load_prediction_file(path, as.integer(similarity_top_k))
  }
  
  rows <- py_to_r(
    rows
  )
  
  
  if (length(rows) == 0) {
    return(tibble())
  }
  
  
  bind_rows(
    rows
  ) %>%
    
    mutate(
      participant_id = participant_id,
      outcome = outcome,
      model = model
    )
}


# =============================================================================
# Load multiple files
# =============================================================================

load_selected_results <- function(
  selected_files,
  similarity_top_k = NULL
) {
  
  if (nrow(selected_files) == 0) {
    return(tibble())
  }
  
  
  result_list <- vector(
    "list",
    nrow(selected_files)
  )
  
  
  for (
    i in seq_len(
      nrow(selected_files)
    )
  ) {
    
    result_list[[i]] <- load_predictions(
      path = selected_files$path[i],
      participant_id = selected_files$participant_id[i],
      outcome = selected_files$outcome[i],
      model = selected_files$model[i],
      similarity_top_k = similarity_top_k
    )
  }
  
  
  bind_rows(
    result_list
  )
}


# Average only predictions with identical participant, symptom, outer-fold,
# and within-fold positions. Matching truth values are required as a guard
# against accidentally combining differently ordered result files.
make_mean_ensemble <- function(prediction_rows) {

  key_columns <- c(
    "participant_id",
    "outcome",
    "outer_i",
    "split",
    "point_i"
  )

  expected_models <- sort(MAIN_MODEL_DIRS)
  observed_models <- sort(unique(prediction_rows$model))

  if (!identical(observed_models, expected_models)) {
    stop(
      "The exploratory ensemble requires one prediction file from each of the three main models."
    )
  }

  alignment_check <- prediction_rows %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(key_columns))) %>%
    summarise(
      model_count = n_distinct(model),
      row_count = n(),
      truth_range = max(y_true) - min(y_true),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  if (any(
    alignment_check$model_count != length(MAIN_MODEL_DIRS) |
      alignment_check$row_count != length(MAIN_MODEL_DIRS) |
      alignment_check$truth_range > 1e-8
  )) {
    stop(
      "The three model outputs do not have the same test observations, so their predictions cannot be averaged safely."
    )
  }

  prediction_rows %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(key_columns))) %>%
    summarise(
      y_true = first(y_true),
      y_pred = mean(y_pred),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      model = ENSEMBLE_MODEL_NAME
    )
}


# Recalculate the saved checkpoint-transfer blend from its two stored
# components. This is instantaneous and never reloads a PyTorch checkpoint.
make_checkpoint_transfer_blend <- function(
  prediction_rows,
  personal_weight
) {

  required_columns <- c(
    "y_pred_personal",
    "y_pred_other_participants"
  )

  if (!all(required_columns %in% names(prediction_rows))) {
    stop(
      "These checkpoint-transfer result files do not contain the two prediction components needed to change the blend."
    )
  }

  if (any(!is.finite(prediction_rows$y_pred_personal)) ||
      any(!is.finite(prediction_rows$y_pred_other_participants))) {
    stop(
      "The checkpoint-transfer result files have missing prediction components, so the blend cannot be recalculated safely."
    )
  }

  other_participants_weight <- 1 - personal_weight

  prediction_rows %>%
    mutate(
      y_pred =
        personal_weight * y_pred_personal +
        other_participants_weight * y_pred_other_participants,
      model = model_display_name(model)
    )
}


# =============================================================================
# Safe correlation
# =============================================================================

safe_cor <- function(
  x,
  y,
  method = "pearson"
) {
  
  keep <- complete.cases(
    x,
    y
  )
  
  x <- x[keep]
  y <- y[keep]
  
  
  if (
    length(x) < 2 ||
    sd(x) == 0 ||
    sd(y) == 0
  ) {
    
    return(
      NA_real_
    )
  }
  
  
  cor(
    x,
    y,
    method = method
  )
}


# =============================================================================
# Safe correlation test
# =============================================================================

safe_cor_test <- function(
  x,
  y,
  method = "pearson"
) {
  
  keep <- complete.cases(
    x,
    y
  )
  
  x <- x[keep]
  y <- y[keep]
  
  if (
    length(x) < 3 ||
    sd(x) == 0 ||
    sd(y) == 0
  ) {
    
    return(
      tibble(
        r = NA_real_,
        p = NA_real_
      )
    )
  }
  
  if (method == "spearman") {
    test <- cor.test(
      x,
      y,
      method = "spearman",
      exact = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    test <- cor.test(
      x,
      y,
      method = "pearson"
    )
  }
  
tibble(
    r = unname(test$estimate),
    p = test$p.value
  )
}


# =============================================================================
# Pointwise metric helpers
# =============================================================================

clean_metric_pair <- function(
  y_true,
  y_pred
) {

  keep <- complete.cases(
    y_true,
    y_pred
  )

  list(
    y_true = as.numeric(y_true[keep]),
    y_pred = as.numeric(y_pred[keep])
  )
}


safe_mse <- function(
  y_true,
  y_pred
) {

  clean <- clean_metric_pair(
    y_true,
    y_pred
  )

  if (length(clean$y_true) == 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  mean(
    (clean$y_true - clean$y_pred)^2
  )
}


safe_mae <- function(
  y_true,
  y_pred
) {

  clean <- clean_metric_pair(
    y_true,
    y_pred
  )

  if (length(clean$y_true) == 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  mean(
    abs(clean$y_true - clean$y_pred)
  )
}


safe_rmse <- function(
  y_true,
  y_pred
) {

  mse <- safe_mse(
    y_true,
    y_pred
  )

  if (is.na(mse)) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  sqrt(mse)
}


safe_r2 <- function(
  y_true,
  y_pred
) {

  clean <- clean_metric_pair(
    y_true,
    y_pred
  )

  if (length(clean$y_true) == 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  sst <- sum(
    (clean$y_true - mean(clean$y_true))^2
  )

  if (sst == 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  sse <- sum(
    (clean$y_true - clean$y_pred)^2
  )

  1 - sse / sst
}


# =============================================================================
# Bounded DTW
#
# Sakoe-Chiba band + absolute local distance.
# With w = 0 and equally long series, this reduces to MAE.
# =============================================================================

bounded_dtw <- function(
  y_true,
  y_pred,
  warping_radius
) {
  
  y_true <- as.numeric(y_true)
  y_pred <- as.numeric(y_pred)
  
  
  keep <- complete.cases(
    y_true,
    y_pred
  )
  
  y_true <- y_true[keep]
  y_pred <- y_pred[keep]
  
  
  if (
    length(y_true) == 0 ||
    length(y_pred) == 0
  ) {
    
    return(
      list(
        distance = NA_real_,
        path = NULL
      )
    )
  }
  
  
  n_true <- length(y_true)
  n_pred <- length(y_pred)
  
  if (is.finite(warping_radius)) {

    radius <- max(
      0,
      as.integer(warping_radius)
    )

  } else {

    radius <- max(
      n_true,
      n_pred
    )
  }
  
  
  costs <- matrix(
    Inf,
    nrow = n_true + 1,
    ncol = n_pred + 1
  )
  
  
  back <- matrix(
    NA_integer_,
    nrow = n_true + 1,
    ncol = n_pred + 1
  )
  
  
  costs[1, 1] <- 0
  
  
  for (i in seq_len(n_true)) {
    
    j_start <- max(
      1,
      i - radius
    )
    
    j_end <- min(
      n_pred,
      i + radius
    )
    
    
    for (j in j_start:j_end) {
      
      local_cost <- abs(
        y_true[i] -
          y_pred[j]
      )
      
      
      candidates <- c(
        costs[i, j],
        costs[i, j + 1],
        costs[i + 1, j]
      )
      
      
      move <- which.min(
        candidates
      )
      
      
      best_prev <- candidates[
        move
      ]
      
      
      if (is.finite(best_prev)) {
        
        costs[
          i + 1,
          j + 1
        ] <- local_cost +
          best_prev
        
        back[
          i + 1,
          j + 1
        ] <- move
      }
    }
  }
  
  
  if (
    !is.finite(
      costs[
        n_true + 1,
        n_pred + 1
      ]
    )
  ) {
    
    return(
      list(
        distance = NA_real_,
        path = NULL
      )
    )
  }
  
  
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Backtrack optimal path
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  
  path_i <- integer()
  path_j <- integer()
  
  i <- n_true
  j <- n_pred
  
  
  while (
    i > 0 &&
    j > 0
  ) {
    
    path_i <- c(
      i,
      path_i
    )
    
    path_j <- c(
      j,
      path_j
    )
    
    
    move <- back[
      i + 1,
      j + 1
    ]
    
    
    if (is.na(move)) {
      break
    }
    
    
    if (move == 1) {
      
      i <- i - 1
      j <- j - 1
      
    } else if (move == 2) {
      
      i <- i - 1
      
    } else if (move == 3) {
      
      j <- j - 1
    }
  }
  
  
  path <- tibble(
    true_index = path_i,
    pred_index = path_j
  )
  
  
  path_length <- max(
    nrow(path),
    1
  )
  
  
  distance <- costs[
    n_true + 1,
    n_pred + 1
  ] /
    path_length


  list(
    distance = distance,
    path = path
  )
}


# =============================================================================
# Frozen DTW helpers
# =============================================================================

normalize_series_position <- function(
  idx,
  n
) {

  if (n <= 1) {
    return(rep(0, length(idx)))
  }

  (idx - 1) / (n - 1)
}


path_to_warping_curve <- function(
  path,
  n_true,
  n_pred,
  grid = DTW_FUNCTION_GRID
) {

  if (
    is.null(path) ||
    nrow(path) == 0
  ) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, length(grid)))
  }

  curve_df <- tibble(
    x = normalize_series_position(
      path$true_index,
      n_true
    ),
    y = normalize_series_position(
      path$pred_index,
      n_pred
    )
  ) %>%
    group_by(x) %>%
    summarise(
      y = mean(y),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(x)

  if (nrow(curve_df) == 0) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, length(grid)))
  }

  if (nrow(curve_df) == 1) {
    return(rep(curve_df$y[1], length(grid)))
  }

  if (curve_df$x[1] > 0) {
    curve_df <- bind_rows(
      tibble(
        x = 0,
        y = curve_df$y[1]
      ),
      curve_df
    )
  }

  if (curve_df$x[nrow(curve_df)] < 1) {
    curve_df <- bind_rows(
      curve_df,
      tibble(
        x = 1,
        y = curve_df$y[nrow(curve_df)]
      )
    )
  }

  pmin(
    pmax(
      approx(
        x = curve_df$x,
        y = curve_df$y,
        xout = grid,
        method = "linear",
        rule = 2
      )$y,
      0
    ),
    1
  )
}


warp_predictions_with_curve <- function(
  y_pred,
  curve,
  grid = DTW_FUNCTION_GRID
) {

  y_pred <- as.numeric(y_pred)

  if (
    length(y_pred) == 0 ||
    length(curve) == 0 ||
    all(!is.finite(curve))
  ) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, length(y_pred)))
  }

  if (length(y_pred) == 1) {
    return(y_pred)
  }

  test_positions <- normalize_series_position(
    seq_along(y_pred),
    length(y_pred)
  )

  warped_positions <- approx(
    x = grid,
    y = curve,
    xout = test_positions,
    method = "linear",
    rule = 2
  )$y

  warped_indices <- 1 +
    warped_positions *
      (length(y_pred) - 1)

  approx(
    x = seq_along(y_pred),
    y = y_pred,
    xout = warped_indices,
    method = "linear",
    rule = 2
  )$y
}


compute_frozen_dtw <- function(
  symptom_df,
  n_perm = N_PERM,
  seed = DTW_SEED
) {

  fold_dfs <- symptom_df %>%
    group_by(outer_i) %>%
    group_split()

  frozen_folds <- list()

  for (fold_df in fold_dfs) {

    val_df <- fold_df %>%
      filter(split == "validation") %>%
      arrange(point_i)

    test_df <- fold_df %>%
      filter(split == "test") %>%
      arrange(point_i)

    if (
      nrow(val_df) == 0 ||
      nrow(test_df) == 0
    ) {
      next
    }

    val_alignment <- bounded_dtw(
      val_df$y_true,
      val_df$y_pred,
      Inf
    )

    curve <- path_to_warping_curve(
      val_alignment$path,
      n_true = nrow(val_df),
      n_pred = nrow(val_df)
    )

    if (all(!is.finite(curve))) {
      next
    }

    frozen_folds[[length(frozen_folds) + 1]] <- list(
      val_true = val_df$y_true,
      val_pred = val_df$y_pred,
      test_true = test_df$y_true,
      test_pred = test_df$y_pred,
      curve = curve
    )
  }

  if (length(frozen_folds) == 0) {
    return(
      tibble(
        frozen_distance = NA_real_,
        frozen_p_value = NA_real_,
        frozen_null_mean = NA_real_,
        frozen_null_p05 = NA_real_,
        frozen_n_folds = 0L
      )
    )
  }

  real_curve <- colMeans(
    do.call(
      rbind,
      lapply(
        frozen_folds,
        `[[`,
        "curve"
      )
    ),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  real_residuals <- unlist(
    lapply(
      frozen_folds,
      function(fold) {
        aligned_pred <- warp_predictions_with_curve(
          fold$test_pred,
          real_curve
        )
        abs(fold$test_true - aligned_pred)
      }
    )
  )

  real_distance <- mean(
    real_residuals,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  set.seed(seed)

  perm_distances <- rep(
    NA_real_,
    n_perm
  )

  for (p in seq_len(n_perm)) {

    perm_curve <- colMeans(
      do.call(
        rbind,
        lapply(
          frozen_folds,
          function(fold) {
            perm_alignment <- bounded_dtw(
              fold$val_true,
              sample(
                fold$val_pred,
                replace = FALSE
              ),
              Inf
            )

            path_to_warping_curve(
              perm_alignment$path,
              n_true = length(fold$val_true),
              n_pred = length(fold$val_pred)
            )
          }
        )
      ),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    perm_residuals <- unlist(
      lapply(
        frozen_folds,
        function(fold) {
          aligned_pred <- warp_predictions_with_curve(
            sample(
              fold$test_pred,
              replace = FALSE
            ),
            perm_curve
          )

          abs(fold$test_true - aligned_pred)
        }
      )
    )

    perm_distances[p] <- mean(
      perm_residuals,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  }

  perm_distances <- perm_distances[
    is.finite(perm_distances)
  ]

  if (length(perm_distances) == 0) {
    frozen_p_value <- NA_real_
    frozen_null_mean <- NA_real_
    frozen_null_p05 <- NA_real_
  } else {
    frozen_p_value <- mean(
      perm_distances <= real_distance
    )
    frozen_null_mean <- mean(
      perm_distances
    )
    frozen_null_p05 <- as.numeric(
      quantile(
        perm_distances,
        0.05
      )
    )
  }

  tibble(
    frozen_distance = real_distance,
    frozen_p_value = frozen_p_value,
    frozen_null_mean = frozen_null_mean,
    frozen_null_p05 = frozen_null_p05,
    frozen_n_folds = length(frozen_folds)
  )
}


# =============================================================================
# Correlation along DTW path
# =============================================================================

dtw_path_cor <- function(
  y_true,
  y_pred,
  path,
  method = "pearson"
) {
  
  if (
    is.null(path) ||
    nrow(path) == 0
  ) {
    
    return(
      NA_real_
    )
  }
  
  
  aligned_true <- y_true[
    path$true_index
  ]
  
  aligned_pred <- y_pred[
    path$pred_index
  ]
  
  
  safe_cor(
    aligned_true,
    aligned_pred,
    method = method
  )
}


# =============================================================================
# DTW sweep over warping radii
# =============================================================================

compute_dtw_sweep <- function(
  y_true,
  y_pred,
  warping_radii,
  n_perm = N_PERM,
  seed = DTW_SEED,
  correlation_method = "pearson"
) {
  
  keep <- complete.cases(
    y_true,
    y_pred
  )
  
  y_true <- as.numeric(
    y_true[keep]
  )
  
  y_pred <- as.numeric(
    y_pred[keep]
  )
  
  
  corr_raw <- safe_cor(
    y_true,
    y_pred,
    method = correlation_method
  )
  
  
  set.seed(
    seed
  )
  
  
  results <- vector(
    "list",
    length(warping_radii)
  )
  
  
  for (
    r_i in seq_along(
      warping_radii
    )
  ) {
    
    radius <- warping_radii[
      r_i
    ]
    
    
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Real model
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    
    real_alignment <- bounded_dtw(
      y_true,
      y_pred,
      radius
    )
    
    
    d_real <- real_alignment$distance
    
    
    corr_aligned <- dtw_path_cor(
      y_true,
      y_pred,
      real_alignment$path,
      method = correlation_method
    )
    
    
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Permutation null
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    
    null_distances <- rep(
      NA_real_,
      n_perm
    )
    
    null_corrs <- rep(
      NA_real_,
      n_perm
    )
    
    
    for (
      p in seq_len(
        n_perm
      )
    ) {
      
      perm_pred <- sample(
        y_pred,
        replace = FALSE
      )
      
      
      null_alignment <- bounded_dtw(
        y_true,
        perm_pred,
        radius
      )
      
      
      null_distances[p] <-
        null_alignment$distance
      
      
      null_corrs[p] <- dtw_path_cor(
        y_true,
        perm_pred,
        null_alignment$path,
        method = correlation_method
      )
    }
    
    
    null_distances <- null_distances[
      is.finite(
        null_distances
      )
    ]
    
    null_corrs <- null_corrs[
      is.finite(
        null_corrs
      )
    ]
    
    
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Null summaries
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    
    if (
      length(null_distances) > 0
    ) {
      
      null_mean <- mean(
        null_distances
      )
      
      null_sd <- sd(
        null_distances
      )
      
      null_p05 <- as.numeric(
        quantile(
          null_distances,
          0.05
        )
      )
      
      null_p_value <- mean(
        null_distances <=
          d_real
      )
      
    } else {
      
      null_mean <- NA_real_
      null_sd <- NA_real_
      null_p05 <- NA_real_
      null_p_value <- NA_real_
    }
    
    
    if (
      length(null_corrs) > 0
    ) {
      
      corr_null_mean <- mean(
        null_corrs
      )
      
      corr_null_sd <- sd(
        null_corrs
      )
      
      corr_null_p95 <- as.numeric(
        quantile(
          null_corrs,
          0.95
        )
      )
      
      corr_null_p_value <- mean(
        null_corrs >=
          corr_aligned
      )
      
    } else {
      
      corr_null_mean <- NA_real_
      corr_null_sd <- NA_real_
      corr_null_p95 <- NA_real_
      corr_null_p_value <- NA_real_
    }
    
    
    results[[r_i]] <- tibble(
      
      warping_radius = radius,
      warping_radius_index = r_i,
      warping_radius_label = if (
        is.finite(radius)
      ) {
        as.character(radius)
      } else {
        "Inf"
      },
      
      d_real = d_real,
      
      corr_raw = corr_raw,
      
      corr_aligned = corr_aligned,
      
      null_mean = null_mean,
      
      null_sd = null_sd,
      
      null_p05 = null_p05,
      
      null_p_value = null_p_value,
      
      corr_null_mean = corr_null_mean,
      
      corr_null_sd = corr_null_sd,
      
      corr_null_p95 = corr_null_p95,
      
      corr_null_p_value =
        corr_null_p_value
    )
  }
  
  
  bind_rows(
    results
  )
}


# =============================================================================
# Create DTW results for one symptom
# =============================================================================

get_dtw_for_symptom <- function(
  symptom_df,
  correlation_method = "pearson"
) {
  compute_dtw_sweep(
    
    y_true =
      symptom_df$y_true,
    
    y_pred =
      symptom_df$y_pred,
    
    warping_radii =
      DTW_WARPING_RADII,
    
    n_perm =
      N_PERM,
    
    seed =
      DTW_SEED,
    correlation_method =
      correlation_method
  )
}


# =============================================================================
# Outcome labels
# =============================================================================

outcome_label <- function(
  x
) {
  
  recode(
    x,
    negative = "Negative",
    cognitive = "Cognitive",
    positive = "Positive"
  )
}
```

```{r participant-only-visibility, echo=FALSE}
tags$script(HTML("
  function updateParticipantOnly(mode) {
    if (mode === 'participant') {
      $('.participant-only').show();
      $('.symptom-dtw-only').hide();
    } else {
      $('.participant-only').hide();
      $('.symptom-dtw-only').show();
    }
  }

  $(document).on('shiny:connected', function() {
    var mode = Shiny.shinyapp.$inputValues['mode'];
    updateParticipantOnly(mode);
  });

  $(document).on('shiny:inputchanged', function(event) {
    if (event.name === 'mode') {
      updateParticipantOnly(event.value);
    }
  });

  function placePredictionSections() {
    var predictionTab = $('#section-prediction-explorer');
    var comparisonSections = $('#section-available-results, #section-model-comparison');

    if (predictionTab.length && comparisonSections.length) {
      comparisonSections.appendTo(predictionTab);
    }
  }

  // Run after parsing, then once more after all tab-pane setup is complete.
  $(document).ready(placePredictionSections);
  $(window).on('load', placePredictionSections);
"))
```

```{r excluded-participants-reactive, echo=FALSE}
# Normalize IDs so values such as "00092" from the .pth filenames match
# participant 92 in model_and_baseline_results.csv.
normalize_participant_id <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  suppressWarnings(
    ifelse(
      is.na(as.integer(x)),
      x,
      as.character(as.integer(x))
    )
  )
}

excluded_participants <- reactive({
  if (is.null(input$exclude_participants)) {
    return(character())
  }
  normalize_participant_id(input$exclude_participants)
})

available_results <- reactive({

  results <- raw_available_results()
  excluded <- excluded_participants()

  if (length(excluded) == 0) {
    return(results)
  }

  results %>%
    filter(
      !normalize_participant_id(participant_id) %in% excluded
    )
})
```

```{r selected-data, echo=FALSE}
selected_result_files <- reactive({
  
  req(
    input$model,
    input$mode
  )
  
  
  results <- available_results()
  
  
  # ===========================================================================
  # Participant mode
  # ===========================================================================
  
  if (
    input$mode == "participant"
  ) {
    
    req(
      input$participant
    )
    
    
    selected_files <- results %>%
      
      filter(
        participant_id ==
          input$participant
      )
    
  }
  
  
  # ===========================================================================
  # Symptom mode
  # ===========================================================================
  
  else {
    
    req(
      input$symptom
    )
    
    
    selected_files <- results %>%
      
      filter(
        outcome ==
          input$symptom
      )
  }
  
  
  req(
    nrow(selected_files) > 0
  )

  selected_files
  
})

selected_raw_prediction_rows <- reactive({
  
  pred_df <- load_selected_results(
    selected_result_files(),
    similarity_top_k = if (is_similarity_transfer_model(input$model)) {
      similarity_transfer_top_k()
    } else {
      NULL
    }
  )
  
  req(
    nrow(pred_df) > 0
  )

  if (identical(input$model, ENSEMBLE_MODEL_NAME)) {
    pred_df <- make_mean_ensemble(pred_df)
  }

  pred_df
  
})


selected_prediction_rows <- reactive({

  pred_df <- selected_raw_prediction_rows()

  if (is_checkpoint_transfer_model(input$model)) {
    pred_df <- make_checkpoint_transfer_blend(
      prediction_rows = pred_df,
      personal_weight = checkpoint_transfer_personal_weight()
    )
  }

  pred_df

})

selected_predictions <- reactive({
  
  selected_prediction_rows() %>%
    
    filter(
      split == "test"
    ) %>%
    
    group_by(
      participant_id,
      outcome
    ) %>%
    
    arrange(
      outer_i,
      point_i,
      .by_group = TRUE
    ) %>%
    
    mutate(
      observation = row_number()
    ) %>%
    
    ungroup()
  
})


```

### True vs. Predicted

```{r plot, echo=FALSE}

renderPlot({
  
  pred_df <- selected_predictions()
  
  
  plot_df <- pred_df %>%
    
    pivot_longer(
      
      cols = c(
        y_true,
        y_pred
      ),
      
      names_to = "type",
      values_to = "value"
      
    ) %>%
    
    mutate(
      
      type = recode(
        type,
        y_true = "True",
        y_pred = "Predicted"
      ),
      
      type = factor(
        type,
        levels = c(
          "True",
          "Predicted"
        )
      ),
      
      outcome_label = recode(
        outcome,
        negative = "Negative",
        cognitive = "Cognitive",
        positive = "Positive"
      )
    )
  
  
  # ===========================================================================
  # PARTICIPANT
  # ===========================================================================
  
  if (
    input$mode == "participant"
  ) {
    
    ggplot(
      
      plot_df,
      
      aes(
        x = observation,
        y = value,
        color = type,
        group = type
      )
      
    ) +
      
      geom_line(
        linewidth = 1.15,
        alpha = 0.95
      ) +
      
      facet_wrap(
        ~ outcome_label,
        ncol = 1
      ) +
      
      scale_color_manual(
        values = c(
          "True" = TRUE_COLOR,
          "Predicted" = PRED_COLOR
        )
      ) +
      
      scale_y_continuous(
        limits = c(0, 1),
        breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
        expand = c(0, 0)
      ) +
      
      labs(
        title = paste0(
          "Participant ",
          input$participant
        ),
        subtitle = paste0(
          input$model,
          "  |  True vs. predicted symptom scores"
        ),
        x = "Test observation",
        y = "Symptom score",
        color = NULL
      ) +
      
      theme_ipsum(
        base_size = 13,
        grid = "Y"
      ) +
      
      theme(
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold")
      )
  }
  
  
  # ===========================================================================
  # SYMPTOM
  # ===========================================================================
  
  else {
    
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Correlation and significance for each participant
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    
    facet_stats <- pred_df %>%
      group_by(
        participant_id
      ) %>%
      group_modify(
        ~ safe_cor_test(
          .x$y_true,
          .x$y_pred,
          method = input$correlation_method
        )
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      mutate(
        sig = case_when(
          is.na(p) ~ "",
          p < 0.001 ~ "***",
          p < 0.01 ~ "**",
          p < 0.05 ~ "*",
          TRUE ~ "ns"
        ),
        p_label = case_when(
          is.na(p) ~ "p = NA",
          p < 0.001 ~ "p < .001",
          TRUE ~ paste0(
            "p = ",
            sub(
              "^0",
              "",
              sprintf(
                "%.3f",
                p
              )
            )
          )
        ),
        corr_symbol = ifelse(
          input$correlation_method == "spearman",
          "rho",
          "r"
        ),
        r_label = ifelse(
          is.na(r),
          paste0(corr_symbol, " = NA"),
          paste0(
            corr_symbol, " = ",
            sub(
              "^(-?)0\\.",
              "\\1.",
              sprintf(
                "%.2f",
                r
              )
            )
          )
        ),
        facet_label = paste0(
          "Participant ",
          as.integer(participant_id),
          " | ",
          r_label,
          ", ",
          p_label,
          ifelse(
            sig == "",
            "",
            paste0(
              " ",
              sig
            )
          )
        )
      )
    
    plot_df <- plot_df %>%
      left_join(
        facet_stats %>%
          select(
            participant_id,
            facet_label
          ),
        by = "participant_id"
      )
    
    ggplot(
      
      plot_df,
      
      aes(
        x = observation,
        y = value,
        color = type,
        group = type
      )
      
    ) +
      
      geom_line(
        linewidth = 1,
        alpha = 0.95
      ) +
      
      facet_wrap(
        ~ facet_label,
        ncol = 3,
        scales = "free_x"
      ) +
      
      scale_color_manual(
        values = c(
          "True" = TRUE_COLOR,
          "Predicted" = PRED_COLOR
        )
      ) +
      
      scale_y_continuous(
        limits = c(0, 1),
        breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
        expand = c(0, 0)
      ) +
      
      labs(
        title = paste0(
          tools::toTitleCase(
            input$symptom
          ),
          " symptoms"
        ),
        subtitle = paste0(
          input$model,
          "  |  True vs. predicted scores  |  * p < .05, ** p < .01, *** p < .001"
        ),
        x = "Test observation",
        y = "Symptom score",
        color = NULL
      ) +
      
      theme_ipsum(
        base_size = 12,
        grid = "Y"
      ) +
      
      theme(
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
        axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold")
      )
  }
  
},
height = 1000
)
```

```{r participant-performance, echo=FALSE}
},
digits = 3,
striped = TRUE,
hover = TRUE,
spacing = "s"
)
```

:::

## Dynamic Time Warping

Select a participant for detailed bounded-DTW results, or select a symptom for a cached overview across participants.

::: {.participant-only}

The shaded region shows the permutation-null mean ± 2 SD. The dashed line represents the relevant 5th or 95th percentile of the permutation distribution.

```{r dtw-data, echo=FALSE}

dtw_results <- reactive({
  
  req(
    input$mode == "participant"
  )

  selected_files <- selected_result_files()

  cache_context <- dtw_cache_context(
    selected_files = selected_files,
    model = input$model,
    participant_id = input$participant,
    correlation_method = input$correlation_method,
    n_perm = N_PERM,
    warping_radii = DTW_WARPING_RADII,
    seed = DTW_SEED,
    checkpoint_transfer_personal_weight = if (
      is_checkpoint_transfer_model(input$model) &&
        checkpoint_transfer_personal_weight() != 0.60
    ) {
      checkpoint_transfer_personal_weight()
    } else {
      NULL
    },
    similarity_transfer_top_k = if (is_similarity_transfer_model(input$model)) {
      similarity_transfer_top_k()
    } else {
      NULL
    }
  )

  cached_results <- read_dtw_cache(
    DTW_CACHE_DIR,
    cache_context
  )

  if (!is.null(cached_results)) {
    return(prepare_dtw_display_results(cached_results))
  }
  
  
  pred_df <- selected_prediction_rows()
  
  
  outcomes <- unique(
    pred_df$outcome
  )
  
  
  results <- vector(
    "list",
    length(outcomes)
  )
  
  
  for (
    i in seq_along(
      outcomes
    )
  ) {
    
    current_outcome <- outcomes[i]
    
    
    symptom_df_all <- pred_df %>%
      
      filter(
        outcome ==
          current_outcome
      )

    symptom_df_test <- symptom_df_all %>%
      filter(
        split == "test"
      )
    
    
    sweep <- get_dtw_for_symptom(
      symptom_df_test,
      correlation_method = input$correlation_method
    )

    effective_idx <- which(
      sweep$d_real <
        sweep$null_p05
    )[1]

    pointwise_idx <- which(
      sweep$warping_radius_label == "0"
    )[1]

    sweep$outcome <-
      current_outcome

    sweep$pointwise_distance <-
      if (
        length(pointwise_idx) == 1
      ) {
        sweep$d_real[pointwise_idx]
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }

    sweep$effective_warping_index <-
      if (
        length(effective_idx) == 1
      ) {
        sweep$warping_radius_index[effective_idx]
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }

    sweep$effective_warping_label <-
      if (
        length(effective_idx) == 1
      ) {
        sweep$warping_radius_label[effective_idx]
      } else {
        "None"
      }

    sweep$effective_dtw_distance <-
      if (
        length(effective_idx) == 1
      ) {
        sweep$d_real[effective_idx]
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }

    sweep$effective_dtw_p_value <-
      if (
        length(effective_idx) == 1
      ) {
        sweep$null_p_value[effective_idx]
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }

    results[[i]] <- sweep
  }
  
  
  dtw_df <- bind_rows(
    results
  ) %>%
    
    mutate(
      
      Symptom = outcome_label(
        outcome
      ),
      
      Symptom = factor(
        Symptom,
        levels = c(
          "Negative",
          "Cognitive",
          "Positive"
        )
      )
    )

  write_dtw_cache(
    DTW_CACHE_DIR,
    cache_context,
    dtw_df
  )

  prepare_dtw_display_results(dtw_df)
  
})

```

### DTW Summary

```{r dtw-summary, echo=FALSE}

renderTable({
  
  req(
    input$mode == "participant"
  )
  
  
  dtw_df <- dtw_results()
  
  summary_df <- dtw_df %>%
    group_by(
      Symptom
    ) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      time_shift_result = case_when(
        is.na(effective_warping_label) | effective_warping_label == "None" ~
          "No time shift was clearly better than random",
        effective_warping_label == "Inf" ~
          "Unrestricted time shifting needed",
        TRUE ~
          paste0("Up to ", effective_warping_label, " time steps")
      )
    ) %>%
    
    transmute(
      
      Symptom,
      
      `Raw correlation` =
        round(
          corr_raw,
          3
        ),
      
      `Pointwise distance (w = 0)` =
        round(
          pointwise_distance,
          4
        ),
      
      `Time-shift result` =
        time_shift_result,
      
      `Bounded DTW distance` =
        if_else(
          is.na(effective_dtw_distance),
          "Not applicable",
          formatC(effective_dtw_distance, format = "f", digits = 4)
        ),
      
      `Bounded DTW permutation p` =
        if_else(
          is.na(effective_dtw_p_value),
          "Not applicable",
          formatC(effective_dtw_p_value, format = "f", digits = 3)
        )
    )
  
  
  summary_df
  
},
digits = 4,
striped = TRUE,
hover = TRUE,
spacing = "s"
)

```

The time-shift result asks: “Does allowing the prediction to move in time make it more similar to the real symptom pattern than random predictions?” “Unrestricted” means only the most flexible setting passed that check. “No time shift was clearly better than random” means none of the tested settings passed it.

:::

::: {.symptom-dtw-only}

### Symptom Overview

This overview uses precomputed DTW cache files for the currently selected model, symptom, and correlation type. Run `Rscript precompute_dtw_cache.R` first to populate missing participant results.

```{r dtw-symptom-overview-data, echo=FALSE}

dtw_symptom_overview <- reactive({

  req(input$mode == "symptom", input$symptom)

  result_files <- available_results()
  participants <- unique(result_files$participant_id)

  bind_rows(lapply(participants, function(current_participant) {
    participant_files <- result_files %>%
      filter(participant_id == current_participant)

    cache_context <- dtw_cache_context(
      selected_files = participant_files,
      model = input$model,
      participant_id = current_participant,
      correlation_method = input$correlation_method,
      n_perm = N_PERM,
      warping_radii = DTW_WARPING_RADII,
      seed = DTW_SEED,
      checkpoint_transfer_personal_weight = if (
        is_checkpoint_transfer_model(input$model) &&
          checkpoint_transfer_personal_weight() != 0.60
      ) {
        checkpoint_transfer_personal_weight()
      } else {
        NULL
      },
      similarity_transfer_top_k = if (is_similarity_transfer_model(input$model)) {
        similarity_transfer_top_k()
      } else {
        NULL
      }
    )

    cached_results <- read_dtw_cache(DTW_CACHE_DIR, cache_context)

    if (is.null(cached_results)) {
      return(tibble(
        participant_id = current_participant,
        cache_available = FALSE
      ))
    }

    prepare_dtw_display_results(cached_results) %>%
      filter(outcome == input$symptom) %>%
      slice(1) %>%
      mutate(
        participant_id = current_participant,
        cache_available = TRUE,
        time_shift_result = case_when(
          is.na(effective_warping_label) | effective_warping_label == "None" ~
            "No time shift was clearly better than random",
          effective_warping_label == "Inf" ~
            "Unrestricted time shifting needed",
          TRUE ~
            paste0("Up to ", effective_warping_label, " time steps")
        )
      )
  }))
})

```

```{r dtw-symptom-overview-plot, echo=FALSE}
    ) +
    coord_flip(clip = "off") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(outcome_label(input$symptom), ": effective time shifts"),
      subtitle = "Each bar shows how many participants had that DTW result",
      x = NULL,
      y = "Participants"
    ) +
    theme_ipsum(base_size = 12, grid = "X") +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 17),
      axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold")
    )

}, height = 450)

```

### Model Comparison

The following plots use the participant-level performance measures stored in `model_and_baseline_results.csv`. The exploratory mean ensemble is calculated in the app from matching test predictions of the three main models; it is not written back to the CSV. In **Participant** mode, the participant-level plot follows the participant selected above. In **Symptom** mode, only aggregate results across participants are shown for the selected symptom; individual-participant results are hidden.

```{r comparison-data, echo=FALSE}

# =============================================================================
# Load model/baseline summary results
# =============================================================================

COMPARISON_RESULTS_PATH <- file.path(
  RESULTS_ROOT,
  "model_and_baseline_results.csv"
)

comparison_results <- read.csv(
  COMPARISON_RESULTS_PATH
) %>%
  mutate(
    participant_id = as.character(participant_id),
    target = recode(
      tolower(target),
      negative = "Negative",
      cognitive = "Cognitive",
      positive = "Positive"
    ),
    target = factor(
      target,
      levels = c(
        "Negative",
        "Cognitive",
        "Positive"
      )
    ),
    model = as.character(model),
    result_source = as.character(result_source),
    rmse = sqrt(
      pmax(mse, 0)
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    result_source == "Baseline" |
      model %in% MAIN_MODEL_DIRS
  )


# Calculate the ensemble performance from the exact same matched test rows used
# for the ensemble prediction plots. Reactive caching avoids reloading the .pth
# files while the user changes performance-measure controls.
exploratory_ensemble_results <- reactive({

  ensemble_files <- get_ensemble_available_results()

  # Apply the app-wide exclusion before loading and aligning model outputs.
  # Some in-progress participants have all three files but different test rows.
  excluded <- excluded_participants()

  if (length(excluded) > 0) {
    ensemble_files <- ensemble_files %>%
      filter(
        !normalize_participant_id(participant_id) %in% excluded
      )
  }

  if (nrow(ensemble_files) == 0) {
    return(tibble())
  }

  ensemble_predictions <- make_mean_ensemble(
    load_selected_results(ensemble_files)
  )

  ensemble_predictions %>%
    filter(split == "test") %>%
    group_by(
      participant_id,
      outcome
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      n = sum(complete.cases(y_true, y_pred)),
      corr = safe_cor(y_true, y_pred, method = "pearson"),
      mse = safe_mse(y_true, y_pred),
      mae = safe_mae(y_true, y_pred),
      r2 = safe_r2(y_true, y_pred),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      participant_id = normalize_participant_id(participant_id),
      target = factor(
        outcome_label(outcome),
        levels = c("Negative", "Cognitive", "Positive")
      ),
      model = ENSEMBLE_MODEL_NAME,
      result_source = "Exploratory ensemble",
      corr_p = NA_real_,
      rmse = sqrt(pmax(mse, 0)),
      # Match the text column type in model_and_baseline_results.csv.
      complete = "True",
      file_path = NA_character_,
      load_error = NA_character_
    ) %>%
    select(-outcome)
})


# The checkpoint-transfer result files retain both component predictions, so
# every exploratory transfer variant can follow the blend slider without model inference.
checkpoint_transfer_prediction_components <- reactive({

  if (length(CHECKPOINT_TRANSFER_COMPARISON_DIRS) == 0) {
    return(tibble())
  }

  transfer_files <- bind_rows(
    lapply(
      CHECKPOINT_TRANSFER_COMPARISON_DIRS,
      get_available_results
    )
  )
  excluded <- excluded_participants()

  if (length(excluded) > 0) {
    transfer_files <- transfer_files %>%
      filter(
        !normalize_participant_id(participant_id) %in% excluded
      )
  }

  if (nrow(transfer_files) == 0) {
    return(tibble())
  }

  standard_transfer_files <- transfer_files %>%
    filter(!is_similarity_transfer_model(model))
  similarity_transfer_files <- transfer_files %>%
    filter(is_similarity_transfer_model(model))

  bind_rows(
    if (nrow(standard_transfer_files) > 0) {
      load_selected_results(standard_transfer_files)
    },
    if (nrow(similarity_transfer_files) > 0) {
      load_selected_results(
        similarity_transfer_files,
        similarity_top_k = similarity_transfer_top_k()
      )
    }
  )
})


exploratory_checkpoint_transfer_results <- reactive({

  transfer_components <- checkpoint_transfer_prediction_components()

  if (nrow(transfer_components) == 0) {
    return(tibble())
  }

  transfer_predictions <- make_checkpoint_transfer_blend(
    prediction_rows = transfer_components,
    personal_weight = checkpoint_transfer_personal_weight()
  )

  transfer_predictions %>%
    filter(split == "test") %>%
    group_by(
      participant_id,
      outcome,
      model
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      n = sum(complete.cases(y_true, y_pred)),
      corr = safe_cor(y_true, y_pred, method = "pearson"),
      mse = safe_mse(y_true, y_pred),
      mae = safe_mae(y_true, y_pred),
      r2 = safe_r2(y_true, y_pred),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      participant_id = normalize_participant_id(participant_id),
      target = factor(
        outcome_label(outcome),
        levels = c("Negative", "Cognitive", "Positive")
      ),
      result_source = "Exploratory checkpoint-transfer blend",
      corr_p = NA_real_,
      rmse = sqrt(pmax(mse, 0)),
      complete = "True",
      file_path = NA_character_,
      load_error = NA_character_
    ) %>%
    select(-outcome)
})


comparison_results_filtered <- reactive({

  excluded <- excluded_participants()

  all_comparison_results <- comparison_results

  # Reading every source prediction file is only needed when the user elects
  # to include the exploratory ensemble in a performance comparison.
  if (
    !is.null(input$comparison_models) &&
      ENSEMBLE_MODEL_NAME %in% input$comparison_models
  ) {
    all_comparison_results <- bind_rows(
      all_comparison_results,
      exploratory_ensemble_results()
    )
  }

  if (
    !is.null(input$comparison_models) &&
      any(CHECKPOINT_TRANSFER_COMPARISON_NAMES %in% input$comparison_models)
  ) {
    all_comparison_results <- bind_rows(
      all_comparison_results,
      exploratory_checkpoint_transfer_results()
    )
  }

  if (length(excluded) == 0) {
    return(all_comparison_results)
  }

  all_comparison_results %>%
    filter(
      !normalize_participant_id(participant_id) %in% excluded
    )
})

# =============================================================================
# Model colors
# =============================================================================

MODEL_COLORS <- c(
  "#F04E37",  # strong Aperol orange
  "#FF9A6E",  # peach coral
  "#D97A2B",  # burnt orange
  "#F4B860",  # golden sand
  "#EED9A0",  # pale sand
  "#C9A45A",  # deeper sandy gold
  "#A9DDF2",  # pale sky blue
  "#89D0EA",  # light coastal blue
  "#4C9BC8",  # medium coastal blue
  "#2D6D98"   # deep ocean blue
)


comparison_model_names <- sort(
  unique(c(
    comparison_results$model,
    ENSEMBLE_MODEL_NAME,
    CHECKPOINT_TRANSFER_COMPARISON_NAMES
  ))
)

comparison_default_model_names <- sort(
  unique(c(
    comparison_results$model
  ))
)

comparison_model_colors <- setNames(
  rep(
    MODEL_COLORS,
    length.out = length(comparison_model_names)
  ),
  comparison_model_names
)

# =============================================================================
# Metric helpers
# =============================================================================

metric_labels <- c(
  corr = "Pearson correlation",
  mse = "Mean squared error",
  mae = "Mean absolute error",
  rmse = "Root mean squared error",
  r2 = "R²"
)

metric_short_labels <- c(
  corr = "r",
  mse = "MSE",
  mae = "MAE",
  rmse = "RMSE",
  r2 = "R²"
)

higher_is_better <- function(metric) {
  metric %in% c("corr", "r2")
}

format_metric_value <- function(x, metric) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(x),
    NA_character_,
    if (metric == "corr") {
      sprintf("%.2f", x)
    } else if (metric == "r2") {
      sprintf("%.2f", x)
    } else {
      sprintf("%.3f", x)
    }
  )
}

participant_model_wins <- function(data, metric, models, targets) {
  participant_metrics <- data %>%
    mutate(
      target = as.character(target),
      metric_value = .data[[metric]]
    ) %>%
    filter(
      model %in% models,
      target %in% targets,
      is.finite(metric_value)
    ) %>%
    group_by(participant_id, target, model) %>%
    summarise(
      metric_value = mean(metric_value),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  eligible_metrics <- participant_metrics %>%
    group_by(participant_id, target) %>%
    filter(n_distinct(model) == length(models)) %>%
    ungroup()

  winners <- if (higher_is_better(metric)) {
    eligible_metrics %>%
      group_by(participant_id, target) %>%
      filter(metric_value == max(metric_value)) %>%
      ungroup()
  } else {
    eligible_metrics %>%
      group_by(participant_id, target) %>%
      filter(metric_value == min(metric_value)) %>%
      ungroup()
  }

  win_counts <- winners %>%
    count(target, model, name = "participant_wins")

  participant_counts <- eligible_metrics %>%
    distinct(participant_id, target) %>%
    count(target, name = "participants_compared")

  tidyr::expand_grid(
    target = targets,
    model = models
  ) %>%
    left_join(win_counts, by = c("target", "model")) %>%
    left_join(participant_counts, by = "target") %>%
    mutate(
      participant_wins = replace_na(participant_wins, 0L),
      participants_compared = replace_na(participants_compared, 0L),
      target = factor(
        target,
        levels = c("Negative", "Cognitive", "Positive")
      ),
      model = factor(model, levels = models)
    )
}

# =============================================================================
# Summary helper
# =============================================================================

summarise_metric <- function(data, metric, group_vars) {

  metric_values <- data[[metric]]

  data <- data %>%
    mutate(.metric_value = metric_values) %>%
    filter(is.finite(.metric_value))

  data %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(group_vars))) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      n_participants = n_distinct(participant_id),
      mean_value = mean(.metric_value, na.rm = TRUE),
      sd_value = sd(.metric_value, na.rm = TRUE),
      se_value = ifelse(n > 1, sd_value / sqrt(n), NA_real_),
      lower = mean_value - se_value,
      upper = mean_value + se_value,
      median_value = median(.metric_value, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}


summarise_metrics_for_table <- function(data, group_vars) {
  bind_rows(lapply(names(metric_labels), function(metric) {
    metric_summary <- summarise_metric(
      data = data,
      metric = metric,
      group_vars = group_vars
    )

    metric_summary$mean_median <- paste0(
      format_metric_value(metric_summary$mean_value, metric),
      " (",
      format_metric_value(metric_summary$median_value, metric),
      ")"
    )

    metric_summary %>%
      mutate(
        metric = metric
      ) %>%
      select(
        all_of(group_vars),
        metric,
        mean_median
      )
  })) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = metric,
      values_from = mean_median
    )
}

```

#### Participant-level model comparison

The model comparison below automatically follows the participant selected in the main participant selector above. The last selected participant is remembered if you temporarily switch to symptom view.

```{r comparison-selected-participant, echo=FALSE}

comparison_selected_participant <- reactiveVal(NULL)

observeEvent(
  input$participant,
  {
    if (!is.null(input$participant) && nzchar(input$participant)) {
      comparison_selected_participant(
        as.character(as.integer(input$participant))
      )
    }
  },
  ignoreInit = FALSE
)
```

```{r participant-model-comparison, echo=FALSE}

renderPlot({

  req(
    input$mode == "participant"
  )

  comparison_participant <- comparison_selected_participant()

  req(
    !is.null(comparison_participant),
    input$comparison_metric,
    input$comparison_models
  )

  metric <- input$comparison_metric

  participant_df <- comparison_results_filtered() %>%
    filter(
      participant_id == comparison_participant,
      model %in% input$comparison_models,
      is.finite(.data[[metric]])
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      metric_value = .data[[metric]],
      value_label = format_metric_value(
        .data[[metric]],
        metric
      )
    )

  validate(
    need(
      nrow(participant_df) > 0,
      paste0(
        "No ",
        metric_labels[[metric]],
        " results found for participant ",
        comparison_participant,
        "."
      )
    )
  )

  y_min <- min(
    0,
    participant_df$metric_value,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  y_max <- max(
    0,
    participant_df$metric_value,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  y_span <- max(
    y_max - y_min,
    abs(y_max) * 0.15,
    abs(y_min) * 0.15,
    0.10
  )

  ggplot(
    participant_df,
    aes(
      x = model,
      y = metric_value,
      fill = model
    )
  ) +
    geom_col(
      width = 0.72
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = value_label,
        y = ifelse(
          metric_value >= 0,
          metric_value - 0.06 * y_span,
          metric_value + 0.06 * y_span
        ),
        vjust = ifelse(
          metric_value >= 0,
          1,
          0
        )
      ),
      color = "white",
      fontface = "bold",
      size = 3.8,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 0,
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    facet_wrap(
      ~ target,
      nrow = 1
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = comparison_model_colors,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(
        y_min - 0.10 * y_span,
        y_max + 0.10 * y_span
      ),
      breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 6),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(
        "Participant ",
        comparison_participant
      ),
      subtitle = paste0(
        metric_labels[[metric]],
        " by model"
      ),
      x = NULL,
      y = metric_labels[[metric]],
      fill = "Model"
    ) +
    theme_ipsum(
      base_size = 13,
      grid = "Y"
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_text(
        face = "bold"
      ),
      legend.text = element_text(
        face = "bold"
      ),
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 18
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        size = 10
      ),
      strip.text = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 12
      ),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_text(
        face = "bold"
      )
    )

},
height = 500
)
```

#### Best model by participant

For each symptom, this chart counts how often each selected model had the best result for an individual participant. A participant is included only when all selected models have a finite value for the chosen measure. Exact ties count for every tied model.

```{r participant-best-model-frequency, echo=FALSE}

renderPlot({

  req(
    input$comparison_metric,
    input$comparison_models
  )

  metric <- input$comparison_metric
  selected_targets <- if (input$mode == "symptom") {
    req(input$symptom)
    outcome_label(input$symptom)
  } else {
    c("Negative", "Cognitive", "Positive")
  }

  win_data <- participant_model_wins(
    data = comparison_results_filtered(),
    metric = metric,
    models = input$comparison_models,
    targets = selected_targets
  )

  validate(
    need(
      any(win_data$participants_compared > 0),
      "No participants have finite results for every selected model and this performance measure."
    )
  )

  direction_text <- if (higher_is_better(metric)) {
    "highest value wins"
  } else {
    "lowest value wins"
  }

  ggplot(
    win_data,
    aes(
      x = model,
      y = participant_wins,
      fill = model
    )
  ) +
    geom_col(width = 0.72) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = participant_wins),

      size = 3.8,

    facet_wrap(~ target, nrow = 1) +

      values = comparison_model_colors,
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 6),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.16))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "How often each model is best per participant",
      subtitle = paste0(
        metric_labels[[metric]], ": ", direction_text,
        "; only complete participant-model comparisons are counted"
      ),
      x = NULL,
      y = "Participants where model was best",
```

#### Overall Model Ranking

In **Participant** mode, the overall ranking combines all available participant × symptom results. In **Symptom** mode, it ranks models using only the symptom selected above. The table shows both median and mean ranks and is ordered by median rank. Every measure is shown as `mean (median)`. Higher values indicate better performance for correlation and R²; lower values indicate better performance for MSE, MAE, and RMSE.

```{r overall-model-ranking, echo=FALSE}

overall_model_ranking_table <- reactive({

  req(
    input$comparison_metric,
    input$comparison_models
  )

  metric <- input$comparison_metric

  ranking_data <- comparison_results_filtered() %>%
    filter(
      model %in% input$comparison_models
    )

  if (
    input$mode == "symptom"
  ) {

    req(input$symptom)

    selected_target <- outcome_label(
      input$symptom
    )

    ranking_data <- ranking_data %>%
      filter(
        as.character(target) == selected_target
      )
  }

  ranking <- summarise_metric(
    ranking_data,
    metric = metric,
    group_vars = c("model")
  )

  all_metric_summaries <- summarise_metrics_for_table(
    ranking_data,
    group_vars = c("model")
  )

  ranking %>%
    mutate(
      median_rank = if (higher_is_better(metric)) {
        min_rank(desc(median_value))
      } else {
        min_rank(median_value)
      },
      mean_rank = if (higher_is_better(metric)) {
        min_rank(desc(mean_value))
      } else {
        min_rank(mean_value)
      }
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      median_rank,
      mean_rank,
      model
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      all_metric_summaries,
      by = "model"
    ) %>%
    select(
      `Median rank` = median_rank,
      `Mean rank` = mean_rank,
      Model = model,
      `r mean (median)` = corr,
      `MSE mean (median)` = mse,
      `MAE mean (median)` = mae,
      `RMSE mean (median)` = rmse,
      `R² mean (median)` = r2,
      `Participants` = n_participants,
      `Participant × symptom results` = n
    )

})

renderTable(
  overall_model_ranking_table(),
striped = TRUE,
hover = TRUE,
spacing = "s"
)

downloadButton(
  "download_overall_model_ranking",
  "Download overall ranking (.csv)"
)

output$download_overall_model_ranking <- downloadHandler(
  filename = function() {
    paste0(
      "overall_model_ranking_",
      input$comparison_metric,
      ".csv"
    )
  },
  content = function(file) {
    write.csv(
      overall_model_ranking_table(),
      file,
      row.names = FALSE,
      na = ""
    )
  }
)

```



#### Model Ranking by Symptom

This table ranks models separately for Negative, Cognitive, and Positive symptoms. It shows both median and mean ranks and is ordered by median rank. Every measure is displayed as `mean (median)`. Higher values indicate better performance for correlation and R²; lower values indicate better performance for MSE, MAE, and RMSE.

```{r model-ranking-by-symptom, echo=FALSE}

model_ranking_by_symptom_table <- reactive({

  req(
    input$comparison_metric,
    input$comparison_models
  )

  metric <- input$comparison_metric

  symptom_ranking_data <- comparison_results_filtered() %>%
    filter(
      model %in% input$comparison_models
    )

  ranking_by_symptom <- summarise_metric(
    symptom_ranking_data,
    metric = metric,
    group_vars = c("target", "model")
  )

  all_metric_summaries <- summarise_metrics_for_table(
    symptom_ranking_data,
    group_vars = c("target", "model")
  )

  ranking_by_symptom <- ranking_by_symptom %>%
    group_by(target) %>%
    mutate(
      median_rank = if (higher_is_better(metric)) {
        min_rank(desc(median_value))
      } else {
        min_rank(median_value)
      },
      mean_rank = if (higher_is_better(metric)) {
        min_rank(desc(mean_value))
      } else {
        min_rank(mean_value)
      }
    ) %>%
    ungroup()

  ranking_by_symptom %>%
    mutate(
      Symptom = as.character(target)
    ) %>%
    left_join(
      all_metric_summaries,
      by = c("target", "model")
    ) %>%
    select(
      Symptom,
      `Median rank` = median_rank,
      `Mean rank` = mean_rank,
      Model = model,
      `r mean (median)` = corr,
      `MSE mean (median)` = mse,
      `MAE mean (median)` = mae,
      `RMSE mean (median)` = rmse,
      `R² mean (median)` = r2,
      Participants = n_participants
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      factor(
        Symptom,
        levels = c("Negative", "Cognitive", "Positive")
      ),
      `Median rank`,
      `Mean rank`,
      Model
    )

})

renderTable(
  model_ranking_by_symptom_table(),
striped = TRUE,
hover = TRUE,
spacing = "s"
)

downloadButton(
  "download_model_ranking_by_symptom",
  "Download ranking by symptom (.csv)"
)

output$download_model_ranking_by_symptom <- downloadHandler(
  filename = function() {
    paste0(
      "model_ranking_by_symptom_",
      input$comparison_metric,
      ".csv"
    )
  },
  content = function(file) {
    write.csv(
      model_ranking_by_symptom_table(),
      file,
      row.names = FALSE,
      na = ""
    )
  }
)

```

```{r best-model-by-symptom-summary, echo=FALSE}

renderTable({

  req(
    input$comparison_metric,
    input$comparison_models
  )

  metric <- input$comparison_metric

  best_symptom_data <- comparison_results_filtered() %>%
    filter(
      model %in% input$comparison_models
    )

  best_by_symptom <- summarise_metric(
    best_symptom_data,
    metric = metric,
    group_vars = c("target", "model")
  )

  if (higher_is_better(metric)) {

    best_by_symptom <- best_by_symptom %>%
      group_by(target) %>%
      slice_max(
        order_by = median_value,
        n = 1,
        with_ties = FALSE
      ) %>%
      ungroup()

  } else {

    best_by_symptom <- best_by_symptom %>%
      group_by(target) %>%
      slice_min(
        order_by = median_value,
        n = 1,
        with_ties = FALSE
      ) %>%
      ungroup()
  }

  best_by_symptom %>%
    mutate(
      Symptom = as.character(target),
      `Best model` = model,
      `Median performance` = format_metric_value(
        median_value,
        metric
      )
    ) %>%
    select(
      Symptom,
      `Best model`,
      `Median performance`
    ) %>%
    arrange(
      factor(
        Symptom,
        levels = c("Negative", "Cognitive", "Positive")
      )
    )

},
striped = TRUE,
hover = TRUE,
spacing = "s"
)

```

```{r best-model-summary, echo=FALSE}

renderText({

  req(input$comparison_metric)

  metric <- input$comparison_metric

  ranking <- summarise_metric(
    comparison_results_filtered(),
    metric = metric,
    group_vars = c("model")
  )

  req(nrow(ranking) > 0)

  if (higher_is_better(metric)) {
    median_best <- ranking %>% slice_max(median_value, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
    mean_best <- ranking %>% slice_max(mean_value, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
  } else {
    median_best <- ranking %>% slice_min(median_value, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
    mean_best <- ranking %>% slice_min(mean_value, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
  }

  direction_text <- if (
    higher_is_better(metric)
  ) {
    "highest"
  } else {
    "lowest"
  }

  paste0(
    "Best overall by median ",
    metric_labels[[metric]],
    ": ",
    median_best$model,
    " (",
    direction_text,
    " overall median = ",
    format_metric_value(median_best$median_value, metric),
    "). Best overall by mean: ",
    mean_best$model,
    " (",
    direction_text,
    " overall mean = ",
    format_metric_value(mean_best$mean_value, metric),
    ")."
  )

})

```
